therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: ribonucleotide reductase inhibition combined with nucleoside analog incorporation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA synthesis inhibition and tumor cell proliferation arrest
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with stage II-IVB gallbladder cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: response rate according to RECIST criteria

results.effect_size: 3/33 patients achieved response (9.1% overall response rate)
subgroup_findings: Median PFS similar between strata: 3.7 vs 3.6 months
Median OS better in normal liver function group: 10.3 vs 3.6 months
safety_signals: Neutrophil count decreased (43% in stratum A, 40% in stratum B)
Infection (30% in stratum A, 40% in stratum B)
Anemia (22% in stratum A, 10% in stratum B)
Platelet count decreased (22% in stratum A, 40% in stratum B)
Alkaline phosphatase increased (4% in stratum A, 30% in stratum B)
results.dose_information: Given IV, specific dosing not provided
